title: You CLI command manifest
description: Authored CLI command metadata, inputs, relationships, execution metadata, and handler bindings for one command tree.

formatVersion.description: The explicitly supported version of this command-manifest format.

rootPath.description: The space-delimited command path of the manifest root command.

commands.description: Command records keyed by stable command identifiers. Object keys make duplicate command IDs structurally unrepresentable.

name.description: The final command segment name exposed to users.

path.description: The full space-delimited command path from the manifest root.

aliases.description: Alternate spellings accepted for the final command segment.

groupId.description: Optional Cobra command-group identifier for help grouping.

visibility.description: Whether the command is shown in default help output.

runnable.description: Whether the command exposes a runnable handler.

suggestion.description: Shell-completion and argument-suggestion metadata for one command.

minimumDistance.description: Minimum Levenshtein distance accepted when matching misspelled subcommands.

disableDefaultCmd.description: Whether the default help subcommand suggestion is suppressed.

validArgs.description: Static positional values accepted by the command when no dynamic completion is configured.

usage.description: Invocation-line and example metadata rendered in help output.

line.description: The canonical usage template for the command.

example.description: Optional multi-line example block rendered after the usage line.
